papers.title: FilmFlow: Agentic System for 3D Virtual Film Cinematography

papers.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.desc: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) introduce unique quantization challenges due to their iterative denoising process.

papers.desc: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them.

papers.desc: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration.

papers.desc: Autonomous research agents are increasingly used to automate large portions of scientific research, yet they are prone to research integrity violations (RIVs): behaviors that compromise the validity, reproducibility, or faithfulness of the research process.

papers.desc: As language-model agents grow more capable, they can carry more of a task without asking anyone for help.

papers.desc: Split language models keep input text on a client but send intermediate representations to a server.

papers.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
papers.desc: Diffusion language models can write several tokens in one forward pass, and they decide during generation how many passes to spend.

papers.title: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
papers.desc: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators.
